# All 38 parse and stringify rows

Five fresh-process trials per engine and workload, fixed iteration counts, default GC. M1 / 8 GiB / macOS 26.5.1; Node 26.5.1, Bun 1.3.14. Immutable executable files use identical managed argv[0], CWD and fixture paths.

Array-root parse can defer materialization in the automatic tape window; stringify starts with materialized input. RSS is whole-process peak, including runtime overhead. Retained-memory and complete-lifetime results are saved separately.
